carlos-bulosan.description: A glowing migration route draws itself across darkness, then dissolves into the next gallery.
carlos-bulosan.name: Carlos Bulosan

nvm-gonzalez.description: Bamboo stalks flatten into paper grain as light shifts from green to ivory.
nvm-gonzalez.name: N. V. M. González

graciano-lopez-jaena.description: Columned newsprint floods the frame until only a headline aperture remains.
graciano-lopez-jaena.name: Graciano López Jaena

stevan-javellana.description: War-torn paper brightens into a thin horizontal dawn.
stevan-javellana.name: Stevan Javellana

f-sionil-jose.description: A horizontal timeline thickens into handwritten manuscript lines.
f-sionil-jose.name: F. Sionil José

jose-rizal.description: A drop of ink blooms across parchment into an archipelago silhouette.
jose-rizal.name: José Rizal

amado-v-hernandez.description: Vertical prison bars part like a curtain onto open sky.
amado-v-hernandez.name: Amado V. Hernandez

francisco-balagtas.description: Calligraphic strokes resolve into metal type sorts and printed verse.
francisco-balagtas.name: Francisco Balagtas

lualhati-bautista.description: Typewriter keys strike a doorway that swings open into the next wing.
lualhati-bautista.name: Lualhati Bautista

nick-joaquin.description: Stone gate of Intramuros becomes a luminous portal between centuries.
nick-joaquin.name: Nick Joaquin

jrr-tolkien.description: A hand-drawn map zooms from continent to annotated path (no film grade).
jrr-tolkien.name: J. R. R. Tolkien

gabriel-garcia-marquez.description: A domestic object tips; physics loosens into the marvelous.
gabriel-garcia-marquez.name: Gabriel García Márquez

miguel-de-cervantes.description: Giant blades wipe the scene like a cinematic iris of cloth and wood.
miguel-de-cervantes.name: Miguel de Cervantes

charles-dickens.description: Industrial fog fills the gallery until gaslight points remain.
charles-dickens.name: Charles Dickens

antoine-de-saint-exupery.description: Camera rises from sand and fuselage into star field.
antoine-de-saint-exupery.name: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

george-orwell.description: A searchlight beam cuts the text mid-sentence.
george-orwell.name: George Orwell

ernest-hemingway.description: Prose lines strip away until a single hard horizon remains.
ernest-hemingway.name: Ernest Hemingway

leo-tolstoy.description: A narrow steppe horizon expands to fill the viewport.
leo-tolstoy.name: Leo Tolstoy

william-shakespeare.description: Page texture lifts into wooden stage boards under candlelight.
william-shakespeare.name: William Shakespeare

jk-rowling.description: Turning pages settle into labeled archive boxes on a shelf.
jk-rowling.name: J. K. Rowling
